rows.grounds: compound of mukta (loosened, released) + keśa (hair); describes one whose hair is unbound
compound of śmaśāna (cremation-ground) + stha (standing, situated); indicates location in a cremation ground
compound of balā, saurāṣṭrika, and āyuta (joined, accompanied); exact referents of balā and saurāṣṭrika uncertain without further context
